source.scope: Measured command failure, unchanged existing tests, independent scoped diff and actual standalone sync. No Thunderbird runtime tests.

text: The knowledge repository Git tree listing measured 16,002,952 bytes on October31,2026. The original repository.mjs Git wrapper at a3b6d210a3c09a66524e59a620cdeb2fc0f602f3 used maxBuffer: args[0] === "ls-tree" ? 16_000_000 : 8_000_000. A full sync failed with ERR_CHILD_PROCESS_STDIO_MAXBUFFER before importing the tree. A reviewed local, uncommitted correction changes only that ls-tree cap to32_000_000; all path/mode/type, privacy, immutable-record, citation, locking, branch and push checks remain unchanged. Source SHA256 after the one-constant change is c58c580c4bf95a4b91d3b7a606ee200f97391edc432c6f115a50bcc710af8ae7. Independent before/after source checks passed. All six unchanged knowledge-repository tests passed. A new process then completed the real current-tree safe sync with pulled:true and pushed:true. This is a bounded output-size repair, not a streaming redesign, an unlimited cap, an ingestion-speed benchmark or proof that a running console backend reloaded the module.
title: Knowledge sync exceeded the Git tree output buffer
